facts.text: Minjae wore a gray hoodie every day.
Only Jisoo, Dohyun and Minjae hold the deploy-bot key.
The shared server-room admin card is kept in Minjae's desk drawer. Only Minjae has the drawer key.
Jisoo and Dohyun, friends from a university startup club, co-founded Moonlight Labs.
Minjae, Jisoo's university classmate, joined as the first engineer.
Moonlight moved into the Pangyo building where Mr. Kim worked as a guard.
At move-in, a developer in a gray hoodie signed out the shared server-room admin card.
Minjae built the first prototype; Jisoo rewrote it into the product.
Minjae built deploy-bot, the shared deploy account.
Moonlight raised its seed round.
Minjae's father was hospitalized; Minjae was buried in medical debt.
Hana joined Moonlight as a design intern.
A tech magazine profiled Jisoo as the 'genius CTO'. Minjae was not mentioned.
Dohyun inflated the user numbers in the investor deck (about 3x real users).
Minjae promised to get Hana an internship interview at Nova AI.
Investment terms set for the Mar 16 signing: options vest from signing; a confidentiality breach voids them and triggers a lawsuit.
Jisoo noticed odd repo access and asked Grace who can see the code escrow. Grace sensed trouble but kept the signing date.
Minjae signed a secret consulting contract with Nova AI.
Nova paid Minjae 80 million won upfront, almost exactly his medical debt.
Jisoo found company code pushed to an outside repo from the shared deploy-bot account.
The server-room CCTV light was on that afternoon (it was working).
Messenger: Jisoo asked Minjae about the deploy-bot push records. Minjae said he didn't know.
Dohyun and Jisoo argued loudly about the user numbers. Jisoo said she'd tell Grace herself. Hana heard it through the glass wall.
Dohyun's car left the parking lot.
Minjae asked the guard to switch off the server-room CCTV for 'maintenance'. (He meant to delete the push logs before Jisoo checked them.)
A developer in a gray hoodie asked Mr. Kim to switch off the server-room CCTV for 'maintenance'. Kim didn't know his name.
Minjae handed Mr. Kim an envelope with 500,000 won 'for the trouble'.
Server-room door opened with the shared admin card kept in the dev-team drawer.
Hana saw someone in a gray hoodie in the server-room hallway. No face.
Jisoo emailed Grace: 'We need to talk before signing tomorrow. It's about one of our team.'
Hana left by the front entrance at 23:04.
Taxi app: Hana was picked up outside the front entrance at 23:06.
Jisoo went to the server room to check the logs.
Jisoo was found dead in the server room. Ruled an accidental electrocution.
Jisoo walked in on Minjae pulling the log-server disk. They struggled, and he shoved her into the open live rack. Not planned.
The gray-hoodie developer left by the back door carrying a heavy bag.
The investment was postponed indefinitely.
Incident report: server-rack cover found open, log-server disk missing, no witness statements filed.
Parking barrier log: after Dohyun's car left at 21:10, it never came back in that night.
Dohyun quietly corrected the user numbers and closed a smaller bridge round.
Hana passed the Nova interview but never joined.
Internal audit: at the time of the leak push, only Minjae was on the company VPN. Dohyun buried the result to save the company.
Nova AI launched a near-identical product. Minjae joined Nova as CTO.
Minjae's father died.
Mr. Kim quit his job as a security guard.
First memorial for Jisoo. Mr. Kim's last shift as guard.
Hana became a tech journalist.
Hana's first article: people heard loud shouting that night, and investigation records show the server room was opened at 22:40 with the shared admin card.
During a server migration, the 2016 company messenger backup was found.
Moonlight raised its Series B. Dohyun started the 'Jisoo Han Fellowship'.
Moonlight became a unicorn.
Minjae became CEO of Nova AI.
Mr. Kim saw Nova's new CEO on TV and recognized the gray-hoodie developer's face.
Hana found Minjae's Nova contract and advance in early filings, but Nova's lawyers killed the story.
Detective Seojin joined the cold case unit and opened the Moonlight evidence box.

claims.text: I'm at home, working on tomorrow's demo.
I left at nine and was home all night.
Jisoo and I never argued that night.
I came back around 10:30 for my laptop. Just for a minute.
I had no idea anything was wrong at Moonlight.
I told the police everything I saw back then.
I didn't see anything that night.
There was no leak. Nothing ever left the company.
It was just a difference of opinion.
I first talked to Nova that summer, after everything.
That card? Anyone could use it.
It was a consulting gig. Everyone had side gigs.
Jisoo never told me anything about a leak.

statements.label: What are you working on tonight?
statements.line: An all-nighter. Minjae built the prototype; I'm rewriting it into something we can actually ship.

statements.label: How did the team come together?
statements.line: Dohyun and I met in a university startup club. Minjae joined in December. Cleanest code I know.

statements.label: How's the company doing?
statements.line: We just moved into this building in January. Seed round by the end of the year, that's the plan.

statements.label: Who does what?
statements.line: Jisoo's the face, Minjae's the hands, I'm the money.

statements.label: What are you building?
statements.line: A prototype. Jisoo will make it real. I just make it run.

statements.label: How do you ship code?
statements.line: Through deploy-bot. I built it. Only three of us have the key.

statements.label: Doesn't it bother you that Jisoo gets the credit?
statements.line: ...Somebody has to stand in front. It's fine. It's fine.

statements.label: Who's still upstairs?
statements.line: The new startup that moved in in January. Young people, lights on till dawn.

statements.label: Anything unusual in the building?
statements.line: Quiet building. I like it that way.

statements.label: Who has the server-room admin card?
statements.line: When they moved in, a developer in a gray hoodie signed it out. Never caught his name.

statements.label: Is everything okay at work?
statements.line: Yesterday I found our code pushed to an outside repo from the deploy-bot account. I'm checking the server logs at 11:20.

statements.label: Who could have done it?
statements.line: Only three of us hold the deploy-bot key: me, Dohyun and Minjae. Minjae's dad is in the hospital, I can't imagine him... I'm emailing Grace before we sign.

statements.label: How did Moonlight really start?
statements.line: Honestly? Minjae hacked together the first prototype. I just rewrote it. The magazines love calling me the genius, though.

statements.label: Where are you right now?
statements.line: Home. I left around 9:10. Long day.

statements.label: Did you argue with Jisoo tonight?
statements.line: Yeah, we yelled. She thinks the numbers in our deck are 'creative'. We'll sort it out after we sign.

statements.label: Did you inflate the user numbers?
statements.line: ...Every startup rounds up. She wants to tell Grace. I'll talk her out of it tomorrow.

statements.label: Where are you right now?
statements.line: At home, working on tomorrow's demo.

statements.label: How did Moonlight start?
statements.line: Jisoo made it real. I just hacked together the first prototype.

statements.label: You built deploy-bot, right?
statements.line: Every senior dev has the key. Why? ...Sorry, I have to go.

statements.label: Did you hear anything tonight?
statements.line: Dohyun and Jisoo were shouting around nine. Something about numbers. Minjae's been so kind to me, he's getting me a Nova interview.

statements.label: Have you seen anyone near the server room?
statements.line: A few minutes ago someone in a gray hoodie went down the server-room hallway. I didn't see a face.

statements.label: Did you see anything at the front desk?
statements.line: When I went down for coffee around 10:30, someone in a gray hoodie handed Mr. Kim an envelope.

statements.label: Where's the server-room admin card kept?
statements.line: In Minjae's desk drawer. Only he has the key.

statements.label: Is the server-room CCTV recording?
statements.line: A developer in a gray hoodie asked me to switch it off at 10:30. 'Maintenance.' Didn't get his name.

statements.label: Who's still in the building?
statements.line: Mr. Kang's car left at 9:10. A few people still upstairs.

statements.label: Are you ready for tomorrow?
statements.line: Signing at ten. Options vest from signing, and any confidentiality breach voids them.

statements.label: How has Jisoo seemed lately?
statements.line: Worried. She asked me last week who can see the code escrow. I told her we'd sort it out after signing.

statements.label: What happened that night?
statements.line: There was no fight. It was an accident.

statements.label: Was there ever a code leak?
statements.line: A leak? No. Nothing ever left the company.

statements.label: Where were you that night?
statements.line: I left at nine and was home all night. I keep wondering if I could have done something.

statements.label: How have you been?
statements.line: My father passed in January. ...Nothing I did was enough.

statements.label: Did Jisoo tell you about a leak?
statements.line: Jisoo never told me anything like that.

statements.label: What did you see that night?
statements.line: Nothing. I didn't see anything.

statements.label: What are you doing now?
statements.line: I turned down a job at Nova last spring. I don't know what I'm doing anymore.

statements.label: How are you tonight?
statements.line: Last shift. One year since that night. I can't keep walking past that room.

statements.label: Did Mr. Kang come back that night?
statements.line: His car went out at 9:10 and never came back in. The barrier logs every car.

statements.label: Tell me about the man in the gray hoodie.
statements.line: ...You know what? At 11:30 he went out the back door with a bag. Heavy, like a box.

statements.label: When did the intern leave?
statements.line: The intern? Front door, 11:04. I said goodnight.

statements.label: What's your article about?
statements.line: My first real story. Investigation records show the server room was opened at 10:40 with the shared admin card. And people heard shouting that night.

statements.label: Why this story?
statements.line: Because I owe her.

statements.label: Did you read Hana's article?
statements.line: Old news. People argue at startups.

statements.label: How's Moonlight?
statements.line: We fixed what needed fixing and moved on.

statements.label: Where were you that night?
statements.line: Like I told the police: I left at nine and went home.

statements.label: Who opened the server room at 10:40?
statements.line: Probably someone checking the servers. Ask the infra team.

statements.label: What really happened between you and Jisoo?
statements.line: It was just a difference of opinion.

statements.label: What are you working on?
statements.line: The Jisoo Han Fellowship launches in June. During the server migration we even found her old messages.

statements.label: Tell me about the leak.
statements.line: ...Fine. In April 2016 we ran an audit. At the push time, only one person was on the VPN: Minjae. I buried it to save the company.

statements.label: Where were you that night?
statements.line: I came back around 10:30 for my laptop. Just for a minute.

statements.label: When did you first talk to Nova?
statements.line: That summer. After everything.

statements.label: Whose card opened the server room?
statements.line: That card? Anyone could use it.

statements.label: Are you still on the story?
statements.line: Someone took the log-server disk. The report says so.

statements.label: What do you think of the fellowship?
statements.line: It's beautiful. And a little too late.

statements.label: Nine years. How is Moonlight?
statements.line: A unicorn for three years now. Her chair is still empty.

statements.label: What do you make of Nova?
statements.line: They launched our product six months after she died.

statements.label: Did you know about Minjae's Nova contract?
statements.line: I knew since the audit. I should have said something.

statements.label: How's life as a CEO?
statements.line: CEO since 2023. I'm proud of Nova.

statements.label: What about Hana's story on you?
statements.line: Baseless. Our lawyers handled it.

statements.label: What was the March 2016 contract?
statements.line: A consulting gig. Everyone had side gigs.

statements.label: Nine years on. What are you working on?
statements.line: Still her story. He's a CEO now; everyone loves him.

statements.label: What happened to your story?
statements.line: Nova's lawyers killed it last year.

statements.label: What did you find about Minjae and Nova?
statements.line: Minjae signed with Nova on March 10, 2016. Five days before. 80 million won upfront.

statements.label: What happened the night Jisoo died?
statements.line: A terrible accident. It was a quiet evening. No fights, nothing.

statements.label: What happened to Minjae?
statements.line: Back then he was drowning in his father's hospital bills. Six months later he left, and Nova launched our product. Gray hoodie, big ideas.

statements.label: Hana's article says there was shouting.
statements.line: Okay. We argued. I'd padded the numbers. But I left at 9:10. Check the parking log.

statements.label: Where were you that night?
statements.line: I came back around 10:30 for my laptop. Just for a minute.

statements.label: Why does Nova's product look like Moonlight's?
statements.line: Same industry, same problems. Good ideas converge.

statements.label: Jisoo asked you about deploy-bot that evening.
statements.line: ...She asked. I said I didn't know.

statements.label: What do you remember about that night?
statements.line: I told the police everything back then.

statements.label: What was Jisoo like?
statements.line: Brilliant. A magazine called her the genius CTO. Minjae's name wasn't even in the piece.

statements.label: What do you know about Minjae and Nova?
statements.line: He signed with Nova on March 10, 2016. 80 million won upfront.

statements.label: Do you remember March 15, 2016?
statements.line: I've thought about that night for ten years.

statements.label: Why did you switch off the camera?
statements.line: He asked, and... he gave me an envelope. I thought it was a tip. I've been ashamed ever since.

statements.label: He says he only came back for his laptop.
statements.line: Just a laptop? He walked out the back at 11:30 with a bag. And that face, I saw it on TV in 2023. Nova's CEO. Oh Minjae.

statements.label: What happened to the deal?
statements.line: Postponed indefinitely. Then quietly dead. I had no idea anything was wrong there.

statements.label: Did Jisoo contact you before she died?
statements.line: She emailed me at 11:00 that night: 'We need to talk before signing tomorrow. It's about one of our team.'

statements.label: What would a leak have cost the leaker?
statements.line: The leaker's options would be void, and we'd have sued. That person would have lost everything.

records.title: Incident report (Mar 16, 2016)
records.line: Server-rack cover found open. Log-server disk missing. No witness statements filed.

records.title: Parking barrier log
records.line: Mar 15, 21:10: Dohyun Kang's car exits. No re-entry that night.

records.title: Server-room door log
records.line: Mar 15, 22:40: opened with the shared admin card.

records.title: Taxi app receipt
records.line: Mar 15, 23:06: Hana Yoo picked up at the front entrance.

records.title: Messenger backup (found 2019)
records.line: Mar 15, 19:02 Jisoo: 'Was the deploy-bot push on the 13th you?' 19:05 Minjae: 'No idea.'

records_rule: A record card enters the notebook once the player has visited a timepoint at or after available_from ('start' = from the beginning).
condition_rule: requires_any: unlock when any listed ref is on a pinned card. requires_all: every listed ref must be on pinned cards (2-step questions).

contradictions.label: 2017: home all night after nine. 2019: came back at 10:30.
'Just a minute for my laptop' vs leaving by the back door at 23:30 with a bag.
'First talked to Nova that summer' vs a Nova contract on March 10.
'Anyone could use the card' vs the card in his locked drawer.
'Anyone could use the card' vs the gray-hoodie developer who signed it out.
'Jisoo never told me about a leak' vs her messenger question that evening.
Dohyun denies the fight. (Trap: he's hiding the inflated numbers.)
Grace says she had no idea. (Trap: she pushed the deal for her fund.)
Hana says she told the police everything, but no witness statement was filed. (Trap: the Nova interview.)
2017 Hana saw nothing; 2016 Hana saw the hoodie. (Trap: the Nova interview.)
Dohyun denies any leak. (Trap: he buried the audit to save the company. Follow it.)

compare_rule: Cards A and B match a contradiction if any ref of A and any ref of B form its pair (either order).

solution.motive_rule: Score = main motive + hidden motive (if different), capped at 100. Best answer: m_leak (70) + m_debt or m_credit (30).

DISMISSED.when: Accused Minjae but evidence_rule not met (skip STEP 2)
DISMISSED.title: CASE DISMISSED
summary: You named the right man, but you had nothing to hold him with.
Minjae's lawyer walked him out in ten minutes.

WRONG.title: WRONG SUSPECT
summary: Through the radio you hear a door open, then static.
Jisoo's file goes back into the box.

PARTLY.when: Culprit is Minjae and motive score < 70
PARTLY.title: PARTLY SOLVED
summary: Minjae confesses, but you never understood why.
Your last message reaches Jisoo: 'Don't go to the server room.'
She lives. She asks, 'Why would he...?' The radio goes quiet.

SOLVED.when: Culprit is Minjae and motive score >= 70
SOLVED.title: CASE SOLVED
summary: Minjae was buried in his father's medical debt. Nova paid it off, and he paid them back with Moonlight's code.
That night he only meant to delete the logs. Jisoo walked in, and in the struggle he pushed her into the open rack.
Your last message: 'Don't go to the server room. It's Minjae.' In 2026, Jisoo smiles in the Moonlight team photo.

minjae.breaks: I only went in to delete the logs. She walked in... I just wanted her to stop. I never meant for her to fall.
minjae.holds: You've got a ten-year-old rumor and a hoodie. Talk to my lawyer.

dohyun.rebuttal: I padded some numbers. That's my crime. I was home by 9:30. Check the parking log.

hana.rebuttal: I kept quiet because Minjae promised me a job. That's my shame. But I never went near that room.

kim.rebuttal: I took his envelope and turned off a camera. I never went upstairs. I've regretted it every day.

grace.rebuttal: I was at home in Hannam-dong. I got her email at 11:00 and never got to answer it.

jisoo.T2015.voice: Young co-founder pulling an all-nighter. Warm, sharp, credits Minjae privately.

dohyun.T2015.voice: Energetic co-founder, all about growth and fundraising.

minjae.T2015.voice: Quiet engineer. Built the prototype and deploy-bot. Hides a sting about credit.

kim.T2015.voice: Friendly night guard. Remembers who signed out the admin card but not names.

jisoo.T2016.voice: Sharp, tired, dry humor. Trusts Minjae, slightly suspects Dohyun. Does not know she will die; laughs off warnings.

dohyun.T2016.voice: Ambitious, stressed, defensive about the numbers. At home since 21:10.

minjae.T2016.voice: Quiet and friendly. Claims to be at home (lie). Gets short about deploy-bot.

hana.T2016.voice: 24, design intern. Honest tonight. Heard the fight, saw the envelope and the hoodie, knows where the card is kept.

kim.T2016.voice: Gruff. Admits a gray-hoodie developer asked to switch off the camera, but hides the envelope.

grace.T2016.voice: Cool, precise investor. Has not received Jisoo's email yet.

dohyun.T2017.voice: At the first memorial. Denies the fight and any leak.

minjae.T2017.voice: Grieving father's death. Says he went home at nine and stayed home. Denies Jisoo told him anything.

hana.T2017.voice: Says she saw nothing. Turned down Nova. Lost.

kim.T2017.voice: Last shift, a little drunk, guilty. Opens up when pressed: parking log, Hana leaving at 23:04, the hoodie man leaving by the back door at 23:30.

hana.T2018.voice: First-year reporter. Published the 22:40 card entry and the shouting. Still hides the hoodie.

minjae.T2018.voice: Still says he left at nine. Deflects the card entry.

dohyun.T2019.voice: Softens the fight to 'a difference of opinion'. Confesses the VPN audit only when confronted with both the leak and his own denial.

minjae.T2019.voice: After Hana's article, now says he came back at 10:30 for his laptop. Lies about when he met Nova and about the card.

hana.T2019.voice: Still digging. Focused on the missing log disk.

dohyun.T2025.voice: Unicorn CEO, regretful. Admits he knew about Minjae since the audit when shown the contract.

minjae.T2025.voice: Nova CEO. Calls the contract a consulting gig.

hana.T2025.voice: Found the contract in 2024; story killed. Tells about the contract only when the player can show Minjae's lie and the audit. Still hides the hoodie.

dohyun.T2026.voice: Polished CEO. Denies the fight until shown the article.

minjae.T2026.voice: Repeats the laptop story. Admits Jisoo asked about deploy-bot when shown the messenger log.

hana.T2026.voice: Says she told the police everything.

kim.T2026.voice: Retired, guilty. Confesses the envelope; names Minjae when shown the laptop story and his own back-door memory.

grace.T2026.voice: Regrets never answering Jisoo's email. Claims she had no idea.
